en.headline: Former NPC deputy and educator Ng Hon-mun dies aged 100
en.dek: The Pui Kiu Education Institution said its honorary chairman passed away peacefully on Sunday morning in the company of family.
body: Ng Hon-mun, a long-serving former Hong Kong deputy to the National People's Congress and veteran educator, has died at the age of 100, the Pui Kiu Education Institution confirmed on Sunday.

The institution said its honorary chairman passed away peacefully on the morning of 18 October in the company of his family. Former chief executive Leung Chun-ying, who is also a vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, posted a tribute on social media.

Born in 1926 in Huilai, Guangdong, Ng joined Pui Kiu Middle School as a teacher in 1947 and served as principal and supervisor from 1958. He was a member of the National People's Congress for 33 years from 1975 and later sat on the Basic Law Committee. He received the Grand Bauhinia Medal in 1998.

zh.headline: 前港區人大代表兼教育家吳康民逝世 享年100歲
zh.dek: 培僑教育機構表示，榮譽主席吳康民今早在家人陪伴下安詳辭世。
body: 培僑教育機構今日確認，前港區全國人大代表、該校前校長兼榮譽主席吳康民逝世，享年100歲。
機構指吳康民於10月18日上午在家人陪伴下安詳辭世。全國政協副主席、前行政長官梁振英在社交平台發文悼念。
吳康民1926年出生於廣東惠來，1947年加入培僑中學任教，1958年起擔任校長兼校監。他自1975年起連續出任全國人大代表達33年，回歸後曾擔任基本法委員會委員，1998年獲頒大紫荊勳章。
